melanie_sales: Heads-up Tideway wants to swap off CompetitorY. Main asks: drop-in parity for risk prompts, SOC answers, quick pricing delta. Can we POC?
ryan_se: I can run a small adapter. Need sample prod prompts and their generator params.
melanie_sales: They want minimal code changes. Legal wants ability to switch back during test.
kim_security: We'll need to answer data residency, KMS, audit logs; can fill 70% in 24h.
ash_infra: For parity, tokenization and stop trimming are common diffs. Suggest `compat_mode=competitory_v2` and non-streaming runs.
ops-bot: request accepted: provision sandbox tideway-poc (1 node, EU), ETA 5h.
ryan_se: Plan: 1) shim that maps CompetitorY fields -> Redwood, 2) run 2-day 5% mirror, 3) parity report (exact match + embedding cosine).
melanie_sales: Pricing: show Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private; I'll ask for their monthly token usage.
kim_security: Action: I'll post preliminary SOC answers in 24h.
melanie_sales: I'll schedule kickoff for tomorrow 9am PT once sandbox live. :thumbsup:
